slides.title: Pricing in 2027 while churn is rising

paragraphs.text: Pricing in 2027 while churn is rising
Discussion document for the CEO and leadership team
Palisade Docs
CEO and leadership team
Synthetic benchmark data; every number from the briefing pack
Executive summary
Raise prices in 2027 by segment: mid-market and enterprise from January, SMB only after a test and once the promotion cohort is activated
Churn is rising because of the 2025 SMB promotion, not because core customers reject our prices
–	SMB accounts for 96% of the extra customers lost each month
–	The 2025 promotion cohort explains 91% of the rise in SMB churn
The CFO's 12% plan is worth at most $7.6M, not $10.3M, and hits SMB, where Inkwell undercuts us
–	Only 76% of ARR renews in 2027, and enterprise caps limit the rest
–	Our SMB win rate against Inkwell's $9 plan fell from 51% to 38%
Mid-market and enterprise can carry a rise: they expand, barely churn and value our integrations
–	Net revenue retention is 112% and 118%, against 94% in SMB
–	A 10% higher mid-market price barely moved conversion in 2024
Raise mid-market and enterprise from January for about $4.3M; decide SMB on a test by mid-2027
–	The targeted rise covers 33% of the $12.9M growth target
–	SMB gets an 8% renewal test, with a go/no-go at the end of Q2 2027

paragraphs.text: 1 Churn    2 12% plan    3 Headroom    4 Plan
Mid-market and enterprise renewals alone would add about $4.3M of ARR in 2027 at tested price levels
ARR added by the targeted rise, $ millions, renewals during 2027
mid-market: $34.9M renewing in 2027 (85% of $41.0M) × 10%, the 2024 test level
enterprise without caps: $3.8M renewing × 10%
enterprise with caps: $5.8M renewing × the 7% cap
ARR added by December 2027, before any churn effect and before SMB
The estimate rests on four assumptions
▪	85% of mid-market and 40% of enterprise ARR renew in 2027, as the renewal calendar shows
▪	The 7% caps cover 60% of renewing enterprise ARR, the same share as the whole enterprise book
▪	No extra churn from the rise is netted out; a guardrail pauses the rise if renewed accounts churn faster
▪	SMB is left out: if the 2027 test passes, 8% on the $16.6M of non-promotion SMB ARR adds up to $1.3M
1  Estimate by the team from the briefing pack; live formulas in the Calculations sheet of the source workbook
Sources: Palisade Docs briefing pack (synthetic benchmark data); team analysis

paragraphs.text: Plan on the cohort fix, not the halving
▪	Cohort fix: the best case if promotion customers churned like other SMB, close to the pre-promotion rate
▪	Halving: needs a rate below any in the pack, even the 1.9% SMB settled at after the 2023 rise
▪	Pilot target: track first-month activation (five or more documents) by cohort, every month
